title: MSFS 2024: New Delta A220 Airline Schedules & Guided America VFR Tours!
description:
Looking to add purpose, structured airline schedules, and immersive visual exploration to your flight log in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? The Marketplace just expanded with two brand-new activity packages from Perfect Flight—offering two completely different styles of flying. Whether you want to step into the flight deck for scheduled airline rotations in the Airbus A220 or cruise low and slow across iconic national landmarks, this week's drop delivers hours of focused flying!

In this activity breakdown, we organize the latest marketplace arrivals into clear categories to help you decide what's claiming top priority in your flight log:

✈️ COMMERCIAL AIRLINE OPERATIONS
We kick off with Perfect Flight’s 12 Legs A220 DAL Fall 2026 package. Designed for pilots operating either the Synaptic A220 or Virtualcol A220 series, this expansion delivers an authentic Delta Air Lines livery along with 12 realistic scheduled IFR missions. We look at the immersion features, including authentic aviation audio, real-world airline rotation legs, and over 100 monitored in-flight events that track your procedural execution from gate to gate.

🧭 SCENIC SIGHTSEEING & VFR EXCURSIONS
Ready for a relaxed cross-country journey? Perfect Flight presents Guided Tours America VFR, taking you across 8 handcrafted scenic routes covering over 1,200 nautical miles through 10 US states. We inspect the package's 167+ detailed points of interest, authentic spoken audio briefings, and localized narrations available in six languages—giving you an informative, sightseeing-optimized tour over America's most dramatic national landscapes.

Which of these new activities are you loading up first? Flying scheduled Delta shifts in the A220, or hand-flying a light aircraft across the American wilderness in Guided Tours America VFR? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you find your next flight adventure in MSFS 2024, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
